address_pairs.notes: Taekyung calls Mujin by name while asking him to retrieve the watch and discussing whether to give it to him.

continuity: The System update is complete, and its reward is a very durable pocket watch that appears broken and bears the faint inscription, “A broken clock is right twice a day.” Its significance is unknown.
Taekyung has decided to keep the pocket watch for half a month before deciding whether to give it to Mujin.
The Emperor has summoned Taekyung, and Taekyung agrees to go.
Hong Jin has been promoted to Eunuch Hong and is responsible for the East Depot; the Cang Gong post remains vacant.
Ma Sanbao escaped and evaded the Imperial Army’s three-day search.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s final instruction was to find an unspecified object at a particular place.
plot: After the System update, Taekyung receives a nearly useless-looking, unusually durable broken pocket watch as his reward. He finds a faint inscription on it, gets frustrated, and accidentally smashes through a wall when he throws it. Mujin asks to have the watch; Taekyung decides to keep it for half a month before reconsidering. Jeong Hogun arrives with the Embroidered Uniform Guard and says the Emperor has summoned Taekyung, who agrees to go.
Taekyung and Mujin joke about a password while Jeong Hogun’s group approaches; Taekyung’s teasing irritates Jeong Hogun.
translation_decisions: Use “pocket watch” for 회중시계 and “A broken clock is right twice a day” for the inscription.
Retain the established System terminology and capitalization: System, Update, Reward, Inventory, Item, and Item Window.
